description:
Deimos Archivists

We are the Deimos Archivists, a team of two with skills in web development and graphic design. We are working on the challenge ‘Abandoned but Not Forgotten’ and hope to tell the story of NASA’s abandoned equipment on the Moon and Mars through interactive, interesting storytelling and illustrations for curious school-age space enthusiasts.
summary: Space Adventure is an interactive, child-friendly website designed to introduce younger audiences to the history of space exploration. Through engaging illustrations, storytelling and interactive equipment selections, children can discover the various historical equipment that have shaped our understanding of the Moon and Mars, in an enjoyable way. They are able to play the role of an astronaut and explore the different equipment through a story. This website aims to not only educate school-aged children, but to also spark curiosity about science and the universe. We believe that the visual, interactive elements, and a simple, colourful interface used are important for children, in particular, to understand and explore their interests.
details:
Space Adventure was created to make the history of space exploration more accessible to younger audiences. Many historical space missions leave behind equipment, spacecraft and other objects that hold important scientific stories. However, this information can be difficult for children to explore through traditional scientific resources.

Our project aims to bring these stories to life through an interactive website.

Users can explore two destinations: Mars and the Moon. Each destination features a selection of historical space exploration equipment and objects. Children can browse through these items, select one that interest them, and thereafter discover its story through short, accessible pieces of information.

The key features of this website includes: interactive equipment selection, illustrations to help children visualise space objects, child-friendly explanations, a storytelling approach.

We used NASA resources and historical mission information to research the equipment, missions and discoveries featured on the website. We also used NASA data to aid with illustrations.

Space Adventure aims to spark curiosity about space exploration while helping children understand the importance of objects left behind on the Moon and Mars: they may be abandoned but not forgotten.
